jobs.job_description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a System Administrator I based in Saudi Arabia.

As a System Administrator I, you will play a key role in delivering reliable, high-quality IT support to clients in a remote-first environment. You will troubleshoot and resolve a wide range of technical issues across operating systems, servers, business applications, cloud services, and network infrastructure. Working closely with technical teams, you will help maintain secure, stable, and efficient IT environments while ensuring an excellent client experience. You will also support Microsoft 365 administration, virtualization technologies, and endpoint security, contributing to the smooth operation of client systems. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen your technical expertise, take ownership of complex support requests, and assist other technicians with troubleshooting and escalations. Join a collaborative, service-oriented team that values continuous learning, accountability, and professional development.

Accountabilities

• Provide technical support and troubleshooting: Independently diagnose and resolve workstation operating system issues across Windows and macOS, printer problems, standard business applications, and other common technical challenges.

• Manage server environments: Troubleshoot and maintain server infrastructure running Windows Server 2016 through 2025, helping ensure system availability, reliability, and performance.

• Administer Microsoft 365 and cloud services: Resolve Microsoft 365 administration issues and support Microsoft Entra ID, Azure environments, Active Directory, and related identity and access management services.

• Support virtualization technologies: Maintain and troubleshoot virtualized environments using VMware and Hyper-V to support stable and efficient IT operations.

• Resolve application issues: Provide support for standard office software and line-of-business applications, including Sage ERP and QuickBooks, coordinating with software vendors when specialized assistance is required.

• Maintain network connectivity: Troubleshoot basic and intermediate networking issues involving firewalls, switches, network architecture, and connectivity.

• Protect systems and data: Support backup software, endpoint cybersecurity solutions, mobile devices, and other tools that help maintain secure and resilient client environments.

• Assist and guide technical teams: Act as an escalation point for technicians, sharing technical knowledge and helping resolve issues that require additional expertise.

• Deliver excellent client service: Maintain clear, professional communication, document technical work accurately, and contribute to customer satisfaction and service quality.

• Meet service performance targets: Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including customer satisfaction (CSAT), quality scores, utilization, average time per ticket, and first-touch resolution.

• Provide scheduled on-call support: Participate in a rotation to deliver after-hours and weekend technical support for onsite and remote operations.

• Maintain professional readiness: Complete required training and certifications, follow established procedures, and contribute to a collaborative, client-focused team culture.

Requirements

• Relevant IT experience: At least three years of professional experience in IT support, systems administration, or a related technical role.

• Operating system expertise: Hands-on experience troubleshooting and supporting both Windows and macOS environments.

• Windows Server administration: Practical experience supporting Windows Server versions 2016 through 2025, including common server administration and troubleshooting tasks.

• Virtualization knowledge: Experience managing and troubleshooting VMware and Hyper-V virtualization environments.

• Cloud and identity administration: Experience supporting Microsoft Azure and proficiency with the Microsoft Entra admin center, alongside knowledge of Active Directory and Microsoft 365.

• Networking fundamentals: Working knowledge of firewalls, switches, network architecture, connectivity, and network troubleshooting.

• Business application support: Proficiency in supporting Microsoft Office applications, backup solutions, endpoint security tools, mobile devices, and a variety of business applications.

• Managed service provider experience: Previous experience working for a managed service provider (MSP) is highly desirable.

• Professional certifications: Active server-related certifications are preferred.

• Communication and customer service: Excellent written and spoken English, strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a customer-first mindset.

• Collaboration and accountability: Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, support colleagues, and align with a values-driven, team-oriented work culture.

• Availability: Ability to work full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, from 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time, and participate in scheduled on-call rotations.

• Technical home office: A reliable remote-work setup that meets the following requirements:

• A computer with at least 8 GB of RAM, running Windows 11 with an Intel i5/i7 processor (8th generation or newer), an AMD Ryzen 5/7 processor (2000 series or newer), or macOS 12 or newer.

• A stable internet connection with minimum download and upload speeds of 25 Mbps.

• A quality headset with noise cancellation.

• A smartphone capable of installing Microsoft Authenticator.

• An HD webcam for video meetings.

• A second monitor.

• An uninterruptible power supply (UPS) if using a desktop computer; this is not required for laptop users.

• Assessment and documentation: Ability to pass online behavioral and cognitive assessments and provide any required employment documentation applicable to the hiring location.

Benefits

• Competitive hourly compensation: Starting at $8.44 USD per hour, with the rate varying according to experience and location.

• Healthcare coverage: Comprehensive health plans or health maintenance organization (HMO) coverage for employees and eligible dependents.

• Life insurance: Coverage to provide additional financial protection.

• Flexible benefits reimbursement: Support for eligible dental, vision, mental health, wellness, and government contribution expenses.

• Paid time off: Starting allowance of 15 days per year.

• Parental leave: Maternity and paternity leave benefits.

• Paid US holidays: Paid time off for designated US holidays.

• Night shift bonus: Additional compensation for eligible night-shift work.

• Financial support programs: Access to salary advancement and employee loan options.

• Health and wellness initiatives: Programs designed to support physical and mental well-being.

• Professional development: Company-funded training and certification opportunities to strengthen technical skills and support career progression.

• Remote work: The opportunity to work remotely while supporting diverse clients and technical environments.

jobs.job_title: Windows System Administrator L1 & L2 - Cyber Subnet - Jeddah
jobs.job_description:
Job Title: Windows System Administrator (L1 & L2) | Cyber Subnet | Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

Recruiting Company: Cyber Subnet
Job Location: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Job Type: Full-Time
Application Method:
Positions Available: Multiple Openings (L1 & L2)
Department: IT Infrastructure Team
Reference in Subject Line:
Windows Administrator L1 - Jeddah
Windows Administrator L2 - Jeddah

Position Summary
Cyber Subnet is seeking skilled Windows System Administrators (L1 & L2) to join its growing IT Infrastructure team in Jeddah. These roles are critical in ensuring the reliability, security, performance, and availability of enterprise Windows environments while supporting business-critical systems and end-user services. This is an excellent opportunity for IT professionals looking to advance their careers within a dynamic and technology-driven environment.

Detailed
As a Windows System Administrator, you will play a key role in the administration, support, monitoring, and optimization of enterprise Microsoft infrastructure services. Working alongside experienced infrastructure and operations teams, you will help maintain highly available Windows Server environments, Active Directory services, virtualization platforms, and core networking services. L1 Administrators will focus on day-to-day operations, user administration, system monitoring, and incident resolution, while L2 Administrators will lead advanced troubleshooting, automation, infrastructure optimization, and problem management initiatives. The successful candidates will contribute to maintaining secure, stable, and scalable IT systems that support critical business operations across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
• Administer, monitor, and maintain Windows Server environments to ensure optimal performance and availability.
• Manage Active Directory users, groups, organizational units, permissions, and security policies.
• Configure and support Group Policy Objects (GPOs) across the enterprise environment.
• Monitor server health, capacity utilization, service availability, and system performance metrics.
• Configure and troubleshoot DNS, DHCP, and Windows networking services.
• Perform routine patch management, system updates, and security compliance activities.
• Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve infrastructure incidents within agreed service levels.
• Support VMware and virtualized server environments.
• Execute backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures to ensure business continuity.
• Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base articles.
• Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell scripting (L2 role).
• Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and implement long-term solutions for recurring issues (L2 role).
• Optimize server performance, security hardening, and infrastructure reliability (L2 role).
• Collaborate with cross-functional IT teams to support infrastructure projects and system upgrades.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
• Proven experience in Windows Server administration within enterprise environments.
• Strong understanding of Microsoft Active Directory and Group Policy management.
• Experience managing user accounts, permissions, access controls, and security policies.
• Knowledge of DNS, DHCP, and Windows-based networking services.
• Experience with Windows Server monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
• Familiarity with server patching, updates, and security best practices.
• Hands-on experience supporting VMware or similar virtualization platforms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
• Excellent communication, documentation, and teamwork abilities.
• For L2 candidates, advanced experience with PowerShell scripting, automation, infrastructure optimization, and enterprise-level troubleshooting is required.
• Understanding of backup, recovery, high availability, and disaster recovery concepts.
Nice-to-Have Skills
• Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate or related Microsoft certifications.
• Experience with Microsoft Azure infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments.
• Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory) and identity management solutions.
• Experience with monitoring platforms such as SolarWinds, SCOM, Zabbix, or PRTG.
• Familiarity with ITIL processes, service management tools, and change management practices.
Recruitment Pro Tip

Tailor your CV to clearly demonstrate hands-on experience with Windows Server administration, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, virtualization, and troubleshooting achievements. For L2 positions, highlight PowerShell automation projects, infrastructure optimization initiatives, and detailed examples of complex incidents where you performed root cause analysis and implemented permanent solutions.
#

jobs.job_title: Windows OS System Administrator- Saudi National Only at Muller's Solutions
jobs.job_description:
Windows OS System Administrator-(Saudi National Only) - Muller's Solutions, الدمام, S04, SA.

This Full time on site position offers great opportunities for career growth.

This position offers round-the-clock support, operating 24/7 throughout the year to deliver comprehensive assistance for the enterprise server environment.

The responsibilities include the installation, configuration, management, operation, and maintenance of all Windows server systems and Windows Clusters.

This role is crucial for maintaining system stability through daily operations, patch management, monitoring, and troubleshooting, as well as providing support for SAP environments that run on Windows.
Key Responsibilities
Role Overview

This position operates continuously throughout the year to deliver comprehensive support for the enterprise server landscape.

The individual will be responsible for the installation, configuration, management, operation, and maintenance of all Windows server systems and Windows Clusters.

This role is critical in ensuring system stability through daily operational tasks, patching, monitoring, and troubleshooting, while also providing support for SAP environments hosted on Windows.
Areas of Responsibility
Key Accountabilities
Strategic Management

Ensure that all Windows systems are effectively managed and maintained in accordance with vendor guidelines and security best practices, while also ensuring compliance with NCA, NIC, and SEC Cybersecurity regulations.
Operations Management
• Install, configure, manage, operate, and maintain Windows Server systems and Windows Clusters (e.g., Server 2012, 2016).
• Provide daily operational support, including OS installation, monitoring, troubleshooting, virus protection, and resource management.
• Oversee Windows File shares and clusters, as well as support SAP, SAP HANA, and SAP S/4HANA environments on the Windows platform.
• Consistently review system logs and OS behavior to proactively monitor performance and resolve any issues.
People Management Build Relationships

Collaborate closely with ERP, application, database, and web hosting teams to address daily support and break/fix issues, as well as manage scheduled maintenance.
Process Improvement & Knowledge Management

Manage and maintain client agents for server monitoring (SCOM) and server management (SCCM).

Offer guidance for automation processes within the Microsoft Orchestrator environment.

Develop and maintain both technical and detailed design documentation, as well as operational documentation.

Create, manage, and delete user/group accounts, and enforce account policies.

Raise and oversee support tickets with Microsoft, including troubleshooting, log collection, and follow-up activities.
Requirements
• Degree: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
• Years of Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in enterprise Windows Server administration.
• Technical Skills: Proficient in Windows Server (2012, 2016+) and Windows Clustering.
• Extensive experience with Microsoft System Center (SCOM, SCCM), and knowledge of Microsoft Orchestrator for automation tasks.
• Familiarity with supporting SAP, SAP HANA, or SAP S/4HANA on Windows platforms.
• Skilled in operating system installation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and patch management.
• Experience managing Active Directory, user account configurations, and group policies.
• Generic Skills: Capability to function in a 24/7/365 shift-based work environment.
• Strong documentation abilities for both design and operational processes.
• Excellent skills in collaborating with application and database teams.
• Awareness of cybersecurity regulations (NCA, NIC).
• Decision Making Authority: Empowered to install, configure, patch, and maintain all Windows server systems and clusters.
• Accountable for daily operations, monitoring, and troubleshooting in the Windows environment.
• Authorized to create and manage user/group accounts and policies.
• Responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of vendor support tickets with Microsoft.
Preferred Qualifications
• Familiarity with virtualization technologies (such as VMware or Hyper-V).
• Understanding of network fundamentals and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP).
• Knowledge of system backup and recovery solutions.
• Detail-oriented and organized approach to managing tasks and documentation.
• Passion for technology and eagerness to stay updated on industry trends.
Benefits

Why Join Us: Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.

Competitive salary and benefits package.

Exciting projects and innovative work environment.
#
